description: This file is a Perl module defining functions related to Git packet communication, including reading, writing, and capability negotiation for Git's internal protocol.

methods.name: packet_compare_lists
methods.description: Compares two lists for equality element-wise.

methods.name: packet_bin_read
methods.description: Reads a binary packet from STDIN, returning size and content.

methods.name: remove_final_lf_or_die
methods.description: Removes trailing LF from buffer or dies if not present.

methods.name: packet_txt_read
methods.description: Reads a text packet, returns result code and buffer.

methods.name: packet_key_val_read
methods.description: Reads a 'key=value' line and verifies the key.

methods.name: packet_bin_write
methods.description: Writes a binary packet to STDOUT.

methods.name: packet_txt_write
methods.description: Writes a text packet (with newline) to STDOUT.

methods.name: packet_flush
methods.description: Flushes the packet stream by writing a zero-length packet.

methods.name: packet_initialize
methods.description: Initializes the packet communication with handshake messages.

methods.name: packet_read_capabilities
methods.description: Reads capabilities from the remote end.

methods.name: packet_read_and_check_capabilities
methods.description: Reads remote capabilities and checks for required ones.

methods.name: packet_check_and_write_capabilities
methods.description: Checks local capabilities against remote and advertises them.
